scope: Diagnostic measurements, no production changes. Real Termbox backend in a drained controlling PTY (100x32). Timers cover direct real game/render operations, not OS event polling or physical terminal painting. Normal GC except explicit noauto experiment. Survival HP increased to 100000. Each timed result is retained outside its timer, so instrumentation itself allocates and can shift collection boundaries. Serial runs, one process per variant, not a controlled ABBA release benchmark. Movement run has substantial early host contention; wall and thread CPU are both retained. Charged run was sampled for three seconds and is diagnostic, not a quiet timing baseline.
